message.content: {"note_claim": "The UK plans to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius while securing a 99-year lease for Diego Garcia, where the US military base will continue operating.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Mauritius takes sovereignty of the islands but the UK maintains an initial 99-year lease of Diego Garcia with an option of extension.", "reason": "The Guardian explainer directly states the sovereignty transfer and 99-year lease terms, and that the agreement ensures continued operation of the joint UK-US base on Diego Garcia."}

parsed.note_claim: The UK plans to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius while securing a 99-year lease for Diego Garcia, where the US military base will continue operating.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Mauritius takes sovereignty of the islands but the UK maintains an initial 99-year lease of Diego Garcia with an option of extension.
parsed.reason: The Guardian explainer directly states the sovereignty transfer and 99-year lease terms, and that the agreement ensures continued operation of the joint UK-US base on Diego Garcia.
